pages.text:
Crushes ores into dusts with FE: 20 FE/t for 200 ticks. Raw ores give a dust and a 25% chance of another; ore blocks give two.
Dusts smelt back into ingots. Coal and charcoal crush into carbon dust, a furnace fuel.
Vanilla ores give extra: 6 redstone, 8 lapis, 2 diamonds or 2 emeralds. It also grinds cobblestone to gravel, gravel and sandstone to sand, and bones, blaze rods, wool and glowstone into their dusts and string. It crushes Slag into two Basic Slag, a fertilizer.
